system.description:
A Brined creature is covered in an extremely coarse salt dust for the next minute.

If a Brined creature takes Cold damage, the salt dust hardens and crystalizes. When it does, The Brined creature is Restrained in place until the end of their next turn. This removes the Brined condition.

If a Brined creature takes Lightning damage, the salt dust becomes charged. When it does, The Brined creature gains 1 rank of Shaken each time they move 5 or more feet before the end of their next turn. This removes the Brined condition.
system.summary: Cold damage crystallizes it (Restrained until the end of its next turn); lightning damage charges it (Shaken per 5 ft moved).

rules.text: Cold damage: Restrained until the end of its next turn, then Brined ends. Lightning damage: until the end of its next turn it gains a rank of Shaken each time it moves 5 ft or more, then Brined ends. Lasts 1 minute.
